name: @pgilad/pi-vertex-anthropic
description: Pi extension: Claude on Google Cloud Vertex AI via ADC. Uses the official @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk for real Application Default Credentials (gcloud user creds, service account JSON, GCE/GKE metadata server, workload identity).
author: Gilad Peleg <gilad@giladpeleg.com>
//deps: @anthropic-ai/sdk is a direct dep ONLY to floor the core SDK at the release that added the backendMiddleware hook, which the Vertex URL rewrite needs; with an older core SDK every request 404s as /v1/v1/messages. index.ts never imports it. @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk now declares its own, higher floor (see its dependencies in package-lock.json), so this is a second guard in case a later vertex-sdk loosens that range again. Guarded by test/vertex-wire-shape.test.ts.
